dict.string: Cobux can add itself as a contact so a chat with yourself is named Cobux instead of your own name. It only ever writes that one contact, and never reads your address book.
Cobux uses Face ID to keep your journal entries private.

Cobux can show your mindful minutes and last night's sleep beside your journal entries, so you can see how your writing tracks with how you actually felt. Read-only, stays on your device, and never leaves the app.
Cobux never writes to Health. It only reads your mindful minutes and sleep to show beside your journal entries.

Cobux uses your approximate location to note the temperature and, when you're somewhere unusual, the city beside a journal entry's date. City-level only -- Cobux never stores your coordinates and never reads location in the background.
Cobux uses your microphone in Voice Mode and Spoken Quiz so you can talk to your book wisdom hands-free.
Cobux uses speech recognition to turn what you say into a question for Cobux AI or a graded quiz answer.
